reviews.x: From the picture I thought they covered the nose pieces, but they just stick on like all the others, and don't stay on that long. But at least they are clear, but sitting at a restaurant, my daughter pointed out one had migrated down my nose.

I'm trying to find nose pads that keep my glasses from slipping down my nose.  I've tried many brands.  The Flents Silicone nose pads do keep my glasses from slipping.  But they only last about 2 or 3 days before having to be replaced.  I've found others that last a few days longer.

These silicone nose pads work pretty good, but only for about two days as the other reviewer noted. I was very pleased with their performance during the short time they did work. The adhesive turned into goo and slipped off, getting the goo on my nose. Yuck.

They arrived in good time and were silicone.  The clear composition made them visually nice, but the glue or adhesive became very gooey and I eventually had to remove them and clean the goo (adhesive) from my glasses.

I have tried other silicone stick-on nose pads and have written reviews for them.  I felt these were better than the other two that I tried because it was thinner and didn't look that thick when on my glasses (although silicone, you can still see I have nose pads on my glasses since my frames are black).  In addition, these didn't leave a sticky goo when they were about to fall off.  As for duration, it lasts about the same amount of time as any of the other stick-ons (~2 weeks).

reviews.t: Doesn't last as long as the other band
reviews.x: I thought I would try these over the other brand Apex which I had already tried. These are ok but do not stick as long as the others. They are easily cut into smaller pieces to fit on the plastic nose part of my glasses. They do the job but I was getting about 2-3 weeks out of the others.  This one last about a week it it makes it that long.
does not stick to my glasses very well.The nose pad is very big i doubt anyone would need that. I was expecting a bit more quality but it feels pretty cheap
The nose pads are not screwed on, but rather rubber stickers. They dont last long and and not worth what you paid for. I recommend look elsewhere.

reviews.t: They are a little bigger than I thought but it is easy to cut them to the size and shape you ...
reviews.x: They delivered as promised. I tried them immediately. They are a little bigger than I thought but it is easy to cut them to the size and shape you want. However, after a few hours, I feel uncomfortable and they irritate. So I exam my skin and the area that touch the nose pads become red. Therefore, I give up. I have worn the glasses for about fifty years and I think the area that support the eyeglass pad is vulnerable and not suitable to this kind material.

reviews.t: BEWARE this is a total SCAM!!!!
reviews.x: I would have given a NEGATIVE five if there was such a thing. One star is too much for a product that goes straight to the trash bin. The silicon piece would not stick at all. It peeled off the double sided tape it was sitting on right after I put it on the nose piece and I ended up having double sided tape sticking to the nose piece and earned the trouble to clean it off.

reviews.t: ... came in the mail today and I am as disappointed as all the other 1 star reviewers here
reviews.x: These came in the mail today and I am as disappointed as all the other 1 star reviewers here. These are B-A-D bad! They are thin and the adhesive back does not stay. The only way to salvage these might be to use crazy glue to keep them in one place... which means they are worthless otherwise. Please think twice before purchasing these.

I thought these were replacement nose pads, that screw in, which is what I needed. The stick on pads I received instead will hopefully last me long enough to order what I truly need. They are fine as far as the product goes, I just thought I was getting something else.

I am very disappointed with the nose pads I purchased and plan on returning the ones I haven't used. The price is way overkill for the quantity and quality. The life span once applied to my eye glassses was 2 days. If I had known this I would not have purchased them.

These pads are nothing more than poorly die cut shapes with an "adhesive" back.  They have sharp edges that are uncomfortable and they are no more than 1 millimeter thick and are totally useless.  The adhesive is extremely weak.  A major dissapointment !

Not only are the shapes of the nose pieces not completely cut from the silicone, but the adhesive sticks to the paper backing and not the silicone. Do not waste your money. This is a completely useless product.
There are no nose pads.  It is just a rectange of sticky silicone with an outline that you can try to use to cut out a nose pad.  I wasted my money.
These little guys are actually quiet hard to find. I have to use them on my glasses. They adhere well to the glasses, wear well and last awhile.

reviews.t: Must be old or kept in heat no adhesive
reviews.x: There is no adhesive on the product.  All the adhesive is inside the bag.  They were stuuck to the inside of the package.  I want a refund
They slip & slide off your glasses after about two week. I would choose a different brand, the adhesive on these aren't the best
Only stay on the eyepieces for about 2 days.  Hardly worth the trouble and expense.
Adhesion is worst, Do not it for my nose pad,,,,,,,,,,,

reviews.t: Nose Pads Hold Up Sun Glasses
reviews.x: This is the second time I have ordered these Silicone Nose Pads to help hold up my sun glasses.  They do help hold up your glasses when your skin is slick with sweat or oil.  I pair these with silicone covers for the ear pieces and they work together quite well especially if your glasses are not as tight or do not fit as well as they should.  I would recommend them.

I got these to reduce irritation on my nose from a new pair of glasses and they are not working. Irritation still exists. I thought they looked like a silicone cover that fits over the entire nose piece but nope, just adhesive rubbery material...Guess I need to look some more and call my eye doctor tomorrow...

The item photo is deceptive----these are nothing more than sticky pieces that you adhere to the pads (exactly like the ones you can find for .99 at grocery stores).  Overall they work okay, but not nearly as well as the typical hideous foam ones which work great.  A+ on packing and shipping, though.

These are pretty flimsy, the adhesive is nowhere strong enough to hold these on a pair of glasses. If you buy these make sure you have a set of small clamps and epoxy or super glue. The only way to get them to hold on securely is by applying epoxy and clamping them to the nose bud piece.

claims.text: The adhesive is weak and the pads do not stay on for long, often lasting only a few days.
The adhesive turns gooey and leaves residue on the nose or glasses.
Some reviewers found the pads comfortable or effective while they lasted, and noted they are clear and thin.
The pads can be cut to size or shape, though some found them too big.
Some reviewers expected screw-in replacement nose pads rather than stick-on pads.
